name: mcp-server
summary: Deploys the owned local MCP service used by supported AAP demo integrations.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reconciles the owned namespace, deployment, route, and configuration.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before rollout when cluster readiness or required trusted configuration is unavailable.

readiness: The owned MCP deployment and route are ready.

security.secret_storage: MCP credentials are scoped to the managed integration and are not included in reports.
security.network_trust: The service uses configured ingress and CA trust.
security.external_actions: The server does not create vendor tickets or make autonomous repairs.
